column8: desc=Event Period: {Unit_Begin_End} The Ninja World League is in full swing, where ninja try to prove their worth. This is what you've been training daily for: aim to be the best! You'll receive a reward at the end of the event depending on the grades you acquired. So what are you waiting for?! The Ninja World League awaits!

desc=Event Period: {Unit_Begin_End} The ultimate event is underway that splits the ninja world in two: the Red & White Battle. All entrants are divided into opposing teams; the one with the highest number of total points is declared victorious! As well as prizes for victors, points are up for grabs, which you can use to buy various rewards! Join the Red & White Battle and fight with your comrades to be the best!

desc=A basic Kunai Shuriken. It deals low damage and has no extra effects, but a lot can be carried at once.
desc=A Ninja Tool filled with smoke. It'll explode after hitting a target or after a certain period of time after being thrown and can stop all targets' movements for a moment.
desc=A Ninja Tool shaped like a needle. It has low attack power, but can be thrown in rapid succession. It also has high piercing power and can deflect just about any other Ninja Tool.
desc=A paralysis seal that is placed on the ground. Activates when an enemy is in proximity, paralyzing all targets with range. Affected targets take additional damage upon being attacked.
desc=A seal with a sign that causes an explosion. If placed on the ground, it will explode when a target moves near and deal damage to all targets within range.
desc=A seal with a sign that has healing properties. Used by throwing it forward, it will continually heal allies in range for a set period of time. Can be used on the ground or in the air.
desc=A kunai shuriken with a paralysis seal attached. Paralyzes targets, increasing their damage taken upon being attacked.
desc=A large, foldable Shuriken. It's slow, but has high attack power, and can track targets. It also has high piercing power and can easily deflect other Ninja Tools.
desc=A bomb stuffed with explosives. It'll explode after hitting a target or after a certain period of time after being thrown and deals damage to all targets within range.
desc=A tag that can seal a target's abilities. When it hits, it lowers the target's action speed and healing power.

desc=A special Demon Wind Shuriken that only certain ninja possess. It's slow, but has high attack power and can track targets. It also has high piercing power and can easily deflect other Ninja Tools. This is a special colored variation.

desc=Scientific Ninja Tool embedded with a Wind Style scroll. Launches a target-seeking wind shuriken that creates a tornado on contact and sends the enemy into the air. Decreases the enemy's healing power and disables the use of substitutions.
desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a fire style scroll attached. Launches a ball of fire that explodes on contact, breaking the opponent's guard and engulfing anything nearby in flames.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a lightning style scroll. Fires a lightning attack that makes enemies within a certain range flinch, reducing their attack power and lengthening their Substitution and Ninjutsu cooldown times.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with an earth-style scroll attached. A large rock appears in the user's hand, which they launch at the target, dealing damage while reducing enemy attack tracking ability and evasion range.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a water-style scroll attached. Multiple balls of water appear, damaging any targets they touch while also resetting and extending their Ninja Tool and Ninjutsu cooldown times. The enemy will be unable to use Substitution. This is a prototype and will only last one week.
desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a Rasengan scroll attached. Compresses the swirling chakra into a sphere that strikes the target and deals damage and lowers the target's movement speed.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a purple lightning scroll attached. Launch lightning attacks in four directions, dealing damage to enemies in range. For a short period of time, the move also prevents the user from flinching when getting hit by certain attacks.
