desc=A Ninja Tool shaped like a needle. It has low attack power, but can be thrown in rapid succession. It also has high piercing power and can deflect just about any other Ninja Tool.
desc=A weapon disguised as the tray a maid uses to prepare tea. It is said to be as powerful as the Demon Wind Shuriken.
desc=A Ninja Tool filled with smoke. It activates after hitting a target or after a certain period of time to release smoke that deals damage, lowers received health recovery, and freezes movement.
desc=A Kunai Shuriken with a paper bomb attached. Once it hits a target, it explodes after a certain period of time and damages that target.

desc=A seal with a sign that causes the target's senses to be blurred. It will explode if any target approaches, dealing damage to all within range. Those hit will also have controls reversed for some time.

desc=These are extremely sweet candies handed out at a special "party" once every year. Used by throwing it forward, it will continually heal allies in range for a set period of time. It can be used on the ground or in the air.

desc=A Ninja Tool filled with smoke. Once thrown, it explodes when hitting a target or after a certain period of time, decreasing the target's movement speed, attack tracking ability, and evasion range. This item was specially made for a festival held on a holy night.

desc=Slows the target's movement. It will activate when stepped on by an enemy, decreasing their movement speed, attack tracking ability, evasion range, and Secret Technique gauge, as well as increasing Ninjutsu cooldown times and unable to use Substitution.
desc=Medicine that raises your abilities. Consuming this recovers your health, raises your attack and Ninjutsu attack power, and makes it easier to break your opponent's guard.
desc=Medicine that enhances the user's abilities. When taken, it recovers health, decreases ninjutsu cooldown time, and increases attack, defense and health recovery effects.
desc=A bittersweet treat made with love. Throw it in front of you to heal all allies within range for a set time. Can be used on the ground or in the air.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a shadow clone scroll attached. When used, a shadow clone takes the place of the user, who will instantly appear behind their target. Replenishes user's Substitution stock.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a glimmering flame scroll attached. Fire a burning ring that tracks the enemy. As well as damaging and burning the target it hits, decreasing their movement and defense, it traps them, too.
desc=Medicine that raises your abilities. When taken, it recovers health, increases action speed, attack-tracking speed, and evasion range, while reducing Ninjutsu and Substitution cooldown time.

desc=Medicine that raises your abilities. When taken, it recovers health, removes status ailments, increases ninjutsu resistance, and continually heals the user automatically over a set period of time.

desc=A Demon Wind Shuriken with chakra in its blade. Though this Scientific Ninja Tool is slow, it has high attack power and flies after its target, returning to its user after traveling a certain distance. Its high piercing power can easily overpower other Ninja Tools.

desc=A shuriken for ninjas who want to enjoy summer to the fullest. Except… it's actually a pool float! It's slow, but has high attack power, and can track targets. It also has high piercing power and can easily overpower other Ninja Tools.

desc=A Ninja Tool that creates flashes and smoke. If it hits a target after being thrown, it will cause visual and auditory interference to multiple targets in the surrounding area, stopping their movements for a short time.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a Cooling Breeze scroll attached. Glimmering balls of water shoot forward, hitting targets or bursting after a period of time, sending ripples over a wide range. Targets hit by these ripples will lose any beneficial status effects.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a piercing note scroll attached. This tool summons a shield of floating rocks. The shield will burst and deal damage upon contact, a certain period of time, or after taking a certain damage.
desc=A throwing Scientific Ninja Tool modeled after those used by Kawaki. Larger and heavier than Kunai, it naturally inflicts more damage, but has a shorter range and no additional effects.

desc=Medicine that raises your abilities. When taken, it recovers health, reduces chakra jump charge time, and temporarily renders the user invisible for a set time. However, invisible characters are still vulnerable to attacks.
desc=Medicine that raises your abilities. When taken, it recovers health, boosts close-range attack power, reduces chakra jump charge time, and nullifies incoming attacks for a set time.

desc=A Senbon-type Scientific Ninja Tool. Although not the most powerful of tools, it constantly comes at your opponent, performing three throws in succession. Its powerful piercing ability can penetrate multiple enemies.

column2: Scientific Ninja Tool "Double Moon Sword: Concealed"
column8: desc=This Scientific Ninja Tool features a concealed Double Moon Sword. While evading an attack, unsheathe the blade and lunge at the enemy. During evade, enemy attacks are nullified while Ninja Tool cooldown times and damage are increased.
desc=A spray-type Scientific Ninja Tool with healing properties. Upon use, instantly restores a set amount of health. Also continuously restores health for a set amount of time.

desc=A Shuriken-type Scientific Ninja Tool with Chakra in its blade. It stops in midair once a target is hit or some time after being thrown, inflicting continuous damage to enemies in range and reducing their movement speed.

desc=This is a Blast Bomb shaped Scientific Ninja Tool with a blade made of Chakra. It explodes on impact or after a certain amount of time, dealing damage to targets within range and making them unable to use Substitutions.
desc=A triple-Shuriken Scientific Ninja Tool with blades coated in Chakra. Although they are slow, they have excellent tracking ability.
desc=A drone type Scientific Ninja Tool. Deploys multiple drones to target enemies and cause area damage from afar.
desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool that rapid-fires flame bombs. The user cannot move during rapid fire. However, after a certain amount of time, they can cease fire by jumping or evading.
desc=Basic spike traps that spread out when thrown. They deal damage to enemies when stepped on and decrease movement speed. They also deal damage to targets they collide with in mid-air.
desc=Standard Shuriken. While they deal low damage and have no extra effects, they can be carried in bulk.

desc=A replica of the black staff used by Isshiki Otsutsuki. Extends enemy Substitution and Ninjutsu Cooldown time. Enemies won't see it coming, as it remains in a shrunken state until the user unfurls it to attack.
desc=A Kunai imbued with the Flying Raijin Jutsu Technique Formula. Users will perform a Swift Step forward to the kunai's location either upon impact with an enemy, or after a set duration.
desc=A Ninja Tool resembling the Truthseeker Orb. Places an orb down that fires thorns at the target for a set duration.
desc=A chakram-type Scientific Ninja Tool. Fires two chakrams at the target that return to the user like a boomerang. Reduces the user's ninja tool cooldown time upon return.
desc=A Ninja Tool based on the bow of Kidomaru, one of the Sound Ninja Four. Fires 3 chakra-infused arrows, inflicting damage on hit, or deploys a spider web that reduces the target's movement speed.
desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a chain hook attached. Throw the hook at an opponent, pulling them in and inflicting continuous burn damage on hit.
desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of chakrams. The user spins and dances, attacking the opponent while rushing forward.

desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool with a chain hook attached. Produces a cold wind in an area when swung, dealing damage and reducing movement speed on hit. When used, the move also prevents the user from flinching except when getting hit by certain attacks.
desc=A blade-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. After performing a lunging slash on an opponent, follow up with a spinning diagonal slash. Using this weapon will extend the user's ninjutsu cooldown time.
desc=Launches sand in the shape of a shuriken, dealing damage to enemies hit and reducing their movement speed. User is immune to flinches caused by certain attacks when attacking.

desc=Modeled after the strongest of Ninja Tools, able to employ all changes in chakra nature. Produces a wall of flame, combining with wind to create powerful fireballs. After producing the wall, it can be interrupted by taking another action. When used, resets own ninjutsu stock and increases ninjutsu cooldown time.

desc=A drone-like Scientific Ninja Tool. When used, a drone will hover near your side for a period of time. When an enemy is nearby or if one attacks the drone, the drone will attack and charge at its target.

desc=Uses Ninja Tools to create innumerable shadow clone shurikens to attack the enemy. Creates a clone of the thrown shuriken and leaves it where you stand. After a set duration, the shuriken will fly at an enemy, dealing damage.

desc=A scroll with the Barrier Jutsu "Four Flames Formation" sealed within for easy evocation. Creates a barrier around the area when used, trapping enemies inside. The barrier is dispelled when the clone placed outside is defeated, or if the user spends too much time outside. Enemies take continuous burn damage when they touch the barrier.

desc=A Shuriken Jutsu where the user throws a Shadow Shuriken and uses it as a diversion to close in on the opponent. If it hits, it deals damage, and the user Swift Steps to where it hit. If it misses, it splits apart and deals damage to nearby enemies.

desc=This replica of the Demon Flute used by Sound Four member Tayuya also reproduces the Material Ghosts she used. It releases three Material Ghosts that cause damage to targets they touch and reduce their movement speed and defense.

desc=A drone-like Scientific Ninja Tool. When used, it places a drone where the user stands. The drone will activate after a set period of time and continuously heal nearby allies. While it is active, the user or an ally can touch the drone to make it follow them.

desc=Special ramen from Hidden Leaf Village's famous Ichiraku. Continuously restores health while eating it. When completely consumed, additional health is restored, but movement speed is decreased. This special dish is made using a recipe that keeps it hot. Eating while walking is not allowed at Ichiraku, and eating in front of enemies can be pretty dangerous, so use caution!

desc=A secret medicine passed down by the Akimichi Clan. Greatly enhances physical abilities and prevents some attacks from causing the user to flinch, but also causes health to decline rapidly while active.

desc=This shuriken jutsu wreathes shuriken in lightning before throwing three of them at once and dealing damage. Each shuriken that hits reduces the target's movement speed. If all three hit, the target is restrained.

desc=A scroll with Sealing Jutsu that makes use of iron sand and puppets to restrain enemies. When activated, puppets trail the user, granting increased defense and attack tracking. When the user hits a target with an attack, the puppets connect with threads of iron sand and restrain the target after a certain period of time. The threads will break and dissolve if the enemy gets too far away.
desc=Replicas of the black swords created by the power of the "Six Paths." They do not cause much damage. However, they disrupt the targets' chakra and reduces their health recovery.

desc=A scroll designed to seal and replicate Earth Style: Dark Swamp. When used, it changes surrounding land to a swamp, reducing movement speed, action speed, and evasion of any target that falls into it. The closer a target is to the center of the swamp, the greater the reduction. Also, targets that remain in the swamp for an extended period will be dragged into the ground, knocking them out.
desc=A jutsu that hurls hardened finger bones. Launches in a continuous burst of four shots that increase damage and knock enemies back. Can be canceled quicker than other ninja tools.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Taijutsu that uses chakra to enhance the body, allowing the user to move at ultra speed. Temporarily increases movement speed, close-range attack power, and attack tracking ability on activation.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Taijutsu where the user moves at high speed toward the target and unleashes a low spin-kick. This can break the opponent's guard.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that utilizes a special breathing technique to enhance your physical abilities. Automatically heals the user's health, as well as boosting attack power and movement speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu where the user uses chakra to spit out fireballs. It has lower power compared to other similar moves, but also has a very short cooldown time. Additional input for second attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Shoot out multiple fireballs toward a target. Since multiple fireballs are released at once, it's best used at close range. Disables the use of Substitutions for a set duration on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu launches a massive fireball toward the target. The fireball covers a large range, so it's useful against multiple targets. Temporarily greatly boosts the power of Fire Style ninjutsu and Ninja Tools.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that coats the user's body in Earth Style chakra. During the jutsu, the user cannot move, but is immune to enemy attacks and recovers their health; after the jutsu, their Defense will be increased.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Expels Chakra to create an earthen wall, which deals damage and seals Ninjutsu. The wall will disappear after a certain amount of time or after taking a certain amount of damage. Damage is dealt to enemies when the wall disappears.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that rips up the ground with a shockwave. It knocks back enemies in range and decreases their movement speed, attack tracking, and evasion distance.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Restrains enemies by paralyzing them and temporarily disabling the use of Substitutions. Affected targets also take additional damage upon being attacked.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=Channels chakra toward the injured parts of the body to aid recovery. Continuously heals all allies within range of the user.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Sealing Jutsu that binds targets. Creates a seal around the user that paralyzes all enemies within range, reduces their Substitution stock to zero, and disables their ninjutsu and Secret Techniques. Affected targets also take additional damage upon being attacked.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Quickly substitute something else for your body in order to avoid enemy attacks.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a corporeal clone of the user, allowing them to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Boosts the user's defense temporarily upon escape. The clone lasts for a while, making it easier to hide from enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Summons a great snake. It will remain on the battlefield until either a certain amount of time passes or it takes a certain amount of damage. Direct attacks will leave target paralyzed, preventing the use of Ninjutsu.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Taijutsu where the user concentrates Lightning Style chakra in their arms and thrusts them toward a target at super high speed. Whoever gets hit by the user will get knocked back a great deal.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=Covers the body in Lightning Style chakra and strengthens it. Boosts the user's close-range attack speed, movement speed, and defensive power. Prevents the user from flinching when hit by certain attacks and recovers ninjutsu cooldown. Greatly boosts the power of Lightning Style ninjutsu and Ninja Tools.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Summons a salamander that causes damage and lowers received health recovery. Direct attacks against it will prevent the attacker from using ninjutsu. It will fight until either a certain amount of damage is taken or expires.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Releases lightning that's been knitted together with chakra. The lightning stretches out toward the target and paralyzes them upon impact. Deals damage, decreases attack power, and increases damage taken.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu uses Susano'o to fire Amaterasu's black flames after they've been transformed into an arrow shape.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Summons a toad that deals damage, inflicts paralysis and disables ninjutsu on impact. The toad attacks with bullets that deal damage and lower attack power. Disappears after a set period or after taking a certain amount of damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Jutsu that expels chakra from every orifice of the body. The user can't move during this Jutsu, but it allows them to deflect most enemy attacks while it lasts. Repelled enemies will have their Ninjutsu sealed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates an expanding ball of water that paralyzes, deals continuous damage, and empties the enemy's Substitution stock. Affected targets also take additional damage upon being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=Summons a slug. Heals and removes allies' status ailments and lowers in-range enemies' attack power and defense. Targets paralyzed by direct attacks are unable to use Ninjutsu. Lasts until time runs out or until too damaged.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Increases the effect of gravity on a target, reducing their movement speed, attack tracking ability and evasion distance. Boosts the user's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This jutsu releases chakra-laced insects in order to prevent enemy detection. It blinds all enemies within range, as well as decreases their Attack Power and Defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates multiple blades out of the black flames of Amaterasu and sends them at a target. Deals damage, inflicts continuous burn damage and lowers the target's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A ball of wildly spun chakra forms in the user's fist, and is fired toward the target. Upon impact, it knocks them far back, reducing their movement speed.

column2: Sage Art: Wind Style Rasen Shuriken
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Launches a concentrated amount of rapidly spinning Chakra toward the target in the form of a giant shuriken. The user will not flinch while active, and it reduces the defense and healing power of the target on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=Creates a massive Rasengan and launches it at the target. After impact, the Rasengan will remain in place for a bit. Its range is short, but it's quick to activate. It prevents targets from using Substitution for a time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=Concentrates powerful chakra from the body onto the hand and pierces the enemy. Involves charging toward an opponent and unleashing a sharp thrust.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu expels chakra out from the body in the shape of a giant fireball and launches it toward the target.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that causes lightning to strike down on the target. It creates lightning in the target area and deals damage to all enemies within.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=Smashes the ground with fists imbued with chakra. Paralyzes, disables the use of substitutions, and lowers damage and attack power of all targets within range. Additionally boosts the user's healing power.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=A chakra-based Jutsu used for diagnosis and treatment. It can instantly heal and cure status ailments for all allies within range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=Quickly regenerates parts of the body. Revives unconscious allies, cures status ailments, and completely restores the health of all allies. Also charges their Secret Technique gauge.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that materializes lions out of ink, which will immediately charge toward their target. Upon contact, they'll deal damage and lower the target's action speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates a giant bird drawn from ink and sends it toward the target, sweeping them into the air on hit. Deals damage, disables the ability to lock-on and inflicts ink obstruction.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates gods drawn from ink and sends them charging toward the target. Deals damage, lowers defense and attack power, disables the ability to lock-on and inflicts ink obstruction.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a clone made out of ink, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Interupts the enemy and causes them to become confused.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that infuses lightning style chakra into the user's arm, upon which they charge forward and pierce their target with a powerful thrust.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Visual Jutsu that hypnotizes enemies and copies techniques. Puts the user in Sharingan Mode, granting one-time protection against most enemy Ninjutsu. It also reveals invisible enemies while in use.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=An ability that can teleport any object the user gazes at into an alternate dimension. It can teleport other enemies within range of the target as well, knocking them out and making it impossible for them to be revived.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Infuses Shadow Clone Jutsu with Lightning Style. Uses Lightning Style chakra to create a clone to switch with and escape enemy attacks. Paralyzes the attacking target and lowers their attack power. Has a long cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Spreads thin strands of bark that temporarily restrain enemies. This effect ends if the target is attacked, but the hit deals additional damage. Also reduces the target's attack power.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that creates a wooden wall. It disappears after a certain amount of time passes, or after it takes a certain amount of damage. All targets who get caught up in the creation of the wall will take damage.

column2: Wood Style Hidden Jutsu: Deep Forest Emergence
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates commandable trees that temporarily restrain enemies. This effect ends after a certain amount of time or when damage is taken, but the first hit enemies receive while restrained deals increased damage. Disables enemies' use of substitutions.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a wood clone, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Decreases the movement speed of the attacking enemy.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=The user speeds toward the target's head and slams them into the ground with a heel drop. It can be connected into other attacks.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Taijutsu where the user moves at high speed toward the target and leaps up into the air while hammering the target with kicks and knocking them upward. This jutsu can be connected into other attacks.

column2: Eight Inner Gates: Gate of Limits
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=The user removes one of the limiters in their body in order to forcefully enhance their physical abilities. This boosts their health, attack power, movement speed, attack tracking, evasion range, and attack speed. Additionally, the attack power of Taijutsu is greatly increased.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This Taijutsu can be used to instantly escape from an enemy attack. After performing, you will temporarily have increased movement speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Expands the user's shadow, restricting movement on hit. Affected targets are restrained, have their ninjutsu stock reset, and receive increased damage when first attacked. Additional input causes the user to perform the Shadow Strangle Jutsu, dealing damage and reducing movement speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Turns the user's shadow into piercing needles that spread out in an arc, dealing damage and reducing defense. Affected targets take additional damage upon being attacked for a short duration.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This jutsu allows the user to pull targets in with their shadow. The shadow will temporarily bind and lower the defense of any target it hits, then damage them in an explosion afterwards.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that expands part of the user's body. The user attacks with their expanded arms, breaking the opponent's guard and lowering their attack power. In addition, the user will not flinch while this Jutsu is in effect.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=The user expands their body and rolls forward into a rapid charge. In this form they can move around and knock back enemies, and will not flinch if they're attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that temporarily expands the user's entire body, allowing them to use their massive body to slam the ground and damage all enemies in range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that fires chakra shockwaves out from the user's palms. The shockwave will knock back all targets, damage them, and seal their ninjutsu. Additionally, this jutsu decreases user jutsu cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Visual Jutsu that grants clairvoyance and penetrating sight, allowing the user and allies to see hidden enemies. Increases lock-on distance, as well as both healing and attack power. It reveals invisible enemies and increases the chances of breaking an enemy's guard, while increasing guard durability for the user and allies, allowing them to hold their guard. This also applies to attacks which would normally break through.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=This technique coats the user's arms in shaped chakra as they spin, then thrust forward. This attack inflicts damage and resets targets' Secret Technique gauges.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This jutsu creates a wall of sand that can block attacks. It resets the Ninjutsu and Ninja Tool cooldowns of enemies who are hit by it. It also nullifies enemy attacks while active, but limits the user's movement.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu hardens sand into pellets and fires them. The attack lasts for a period of time, and will lower the action speeds of any targets in range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This jutsu traps the target in sand, rendering them immobile. When the sand disappears, it explodes, dealing damage and increasing respawn time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a clone made out of sand, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Binds and paralyzes the attacking enemy.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates a dragon out of clay that attacks nearby enemies with clay bullets, dealing damage and decreasing movement speed. The dragon will disappear after a set duration or after it takes a certain amount of damage.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that creates two birds out of clay. The birds will fly toward the target and explode upon impact, dealing damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu creates a clay clone of the user. The clones will explode after a period of time, knocking out all targets within range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a clone made out of clay, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. The clone then explodes, dealing damage to targets within range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that fires shark-shaped chakra water bullets. After circling the user, they will shoot towards the target. If they land, the target's Ninjutsu will be sealed, and the user will heal based on the damage done.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu liquefies the nearby ground, allowing the user to travel through it. While traveling through the ground, the user takes no damage and recovers health, but cannot perform any attacks.

column2: Water Style: Super Shark Bomb Jutsu
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=A jutsu that fires a giant chakra water bullet in the shape of a shark. If it hits, it will reset the target's Ninjutsu cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Jutsu that creates a water clone, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. It also lowers the target's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu uses repulsion to knock back targets in range by a great deal and prevents targets from using Substitution for a time. While active, it nullifies certain attacks, such as projectiles with low piercing strength.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu uses attractive force to pull hit targets closer to the user.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=This jutsu creates a core with attractive force, then binds targets in range so that they get sucked in towards the core. After a period of time, all affected targets get slammed down into the ground knocking them out.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Black flames form around the target's feet, reducing their defense. The flames remain for a period of time, and burn anyone they touch, dealing continuous damage.

column2: Fire Style: Phoenix Flame Scarlet Claw
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu shoots out a large amount of Fire Style chakra-laced Shuriken in a radial pattern. Lowers attack power as well as deals damage. The user becomes invulnerable for a brief period as they jump back.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This technique summons Susano'o, who slashes with the Totsuka Blade. This creates a shockwave that moves forward and knocks back anyone in its path. Deals damage and increases respawn time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu creates a bird clone, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. It also has a small chance of lowering the target's attack and defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=This healing jutsu uses chakra to boost the body's ability to recover. It will continually heal the user automatically over a set period of time, and increase their Ninjutsu resistance.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=Forms a sharp chakra blade to attack a target's body and nervous system. Disables the use of Chakra Jumps, Ninjutsu, and Secret Techniques on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=A Genjutsu that hypnotizes targets across a wide area. As well as reducing their Ninja Tools, Ninjutsu, and Substitution stock to zero, it also paralyzes them until a certain amount of time passes, or they get attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu creates paper wings that allow the user to float in the air. When activated, this Jutsu replenishes the user's Ninja Tool count.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=Creates a durable shield out of paper. The shield slowly moves forward, paralyzing any target it touches and reduces their health recovery. Affected targets also take additional damage upon being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a storm of paper across a wide area. Targets in range have their speed and healing power reduced, and they will temporarily be unable to use ninjutsu and Secret Techniques. Also, if enough damage is dealt, an extra attack using Paper Bombs will be activated.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Creates a clone made out of paper, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Interupts the enemy and disables the use of ninjutsu.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=Base;desc=This Jutsu compresses wildly spun-up chakra into a ball, then launches it toward the target. After it's thrown, it disappears and affects all targets within range, extending their Ninja Tool cooldown times.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=A combo attack that involves charging toward an enemy and using a clone to knock them into the air before creating a whirlwind that sucks in surrounding targets. User recovers health on hit. Inflicts damage and lowers healing power on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=This is a combo attack that utilizes the Rasengan. After a Shadow Clone kicks the target into the air, the user fires a Rasengan, which can suck in and damage multiple enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=User leaps forward and crushes the ground. Any target who gets hit takes damage, while the shockwave paralyzes others in range. It also raises the user's attack power.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=Shoots out kunai with healing seals into the surrounding area. Heals allies, reduces ninjutsu cooldown time, and increases ninjutsu resistance for a set duration. User is immune to flinches caused by certain attacks while using this ninjutsu. Activation while airborne will speed up healing, but the duration of other effects may be reduced.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=Base;desc=This jutsu fires out large Kunai with explosive and healing seals on them. Enemies take damage from the explosive seals, while allies are fully restored from the healing seals.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=In this Jutsu, the user extends their arms and knocks back the target. A successful hit will lower the target's movement speed and restore the user's health based on the amount of damage dealt.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=Base;desc=In this Jutsu, the user extends their arms toward the target and pulls them in. It allows the user to absorb health from the target and restore themselves based on how much damage was dealt.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=Base;desc=Allows the user to utilize Sage Jutsu Chakra. In addition to full health recovery, it increases maximum health, attack, defense, movement speed, and tracking ability. However, it seals all other ninjutsu for its duration.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;desc=Channels powerful chakra drawn from the body to a single point on the hand to pierce the enemy. Involves charging toward an opponent and unleashing a sharp thrust.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=With their chakra, the user produces oil that lowers the target's movement speed and seals their Ninjutsu.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Hardens the user's hair to the point that it nullifies most attacks. Also automatically attacks all targets within range and temporarily reduces the healing they receive.

column2: Summoning: Bring Down The House Jutsu
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu where the user summons a super-heavy toad over a target's head and crushes them. The shockwave created sends surrounding enemies flying.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu where the user creates chakra-infused flames. They explode into fireballs, igniting a target on impact.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Uses earth style chakra to create a dragon head, which fires countless earth-elemental projectiles from a fixed position. Reduces the movement speed, attack tracking ability, and evasion range of any target it hits.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The ultimate sealing jutsu. The user summons a Death God who devours the soul of a target, knocking them out and increasing their respawn time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=In this jutsu, the user channels their chakra into scorching-hot, giant fireballs, which, along with the gusts of wind they produce, deal damage to opponents.

column2: Fire Style: Hiding in Ash Jutsu
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Jutsu where the user whisks up hot ashes and dust that explode on activation. It nullifies attacks, reduces the user's Ninjutsu cooldown and removes status ailments.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Produces a gigantic falling boulder that creates a damaging shockwave across a wide range upon impact. Two boulders fall on the target in succession.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Summons a group of snakes that reduces the healing received by the target and poisons them, causing them to take damage for a set duration.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Uses chakra to create a powerful gust of wind. It travels in a straight line, damaging any target it hits while also reducing their attack tracking ability and healing power.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Forbidden Jutsu that revives the dead. The user summons the 1º and 2º Hokage attacking together. Reduces target movement speed and Secret Technique gauge. Cannot be performed by many ninjas at the same time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Creates a clone from numerous snakes, allowing the user to switch out and escape from enemy attacks. Inflicts the attacking enemy with poison.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=This Jutsu allows the user to release a flood of water in the shape of a dragon, which can pass through obstacles and strike a target, causing damage and decreasing movement speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=In this jutsu, the user fires a high-pressure jet of water at a target. It will damage targets and lower their defense. If it hits the ground, a geyser will erupt and do additional damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A paper bomb that makes other paper bombs appear before it explodes, creating carnage. Set in on the ground to create a trap. When a target approaches, it will set off, causing damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that creates a flaming barrier, which protects the character and any allies from a single attack. It also boosts their defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Visual Jutsu that utilizes the Mangekyo Sharingan to nullify enemy attacks when not attacking. Reveals invisible enemies, increases attack power and Chakra Jump speed, and grants a ninja tool stock when triggered.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=In this Fusion Jutsu the user combines Sharingan and Fire Style chakra to send out a flaming whirlwind that burns and damages targets.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that allows the user to teleport. After throwing a marked kunai, the user can move through spacetime to where it landed. Boosts the user's close-range attack power and defense after placing the kunai.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A surprise attack that utilizes the Flying Raijin Jutsu. The user throws a kunai at a target. If it hits, the user will teleport above their target's head and launch a Rasengan. Enemies hit will experience reduced speed and will not be able to use substitutions for a short period of time. The kunai will also hit targets who cannot be attacked due to visual jutsu.

column2: Rasen-Flash Super-Circle Dance Howl Stage Three
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A combo that utilizes Transportation Ninjutsu. The user faces the target and throws six kunai in a furious combo.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Perform a powerful chakra-infused axe kick that damages and paralyzes enemies within range, disables the use of Substitutions and resets ninjutsu cooldown times. Boosts the user's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu where the user electrocutes a target, affecting their nervous system. As well as damaging them, it will reverse their controls for a while.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=A Medical Ninjutsu where tiny Katsuyus latch on to the user and all allies, recovering their health and Secret Technique gauge for as long as they are attached. It also raises defense and removes status ailments.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Sends chakra into the ground to create controllable wooden hands. These appear at the target's feet, dealing damage while also lowering movement speed, attack tracking ability, and evasion range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Jutsu that creates a huge dragon from a tree. It homes in on targets, reducing their Secret Technique gauge on impact, while reducing its own cooldown time. The user's health is recovered according to the amount of damage caused.

column2: Sage Art, Wood Style: Shinsu Senju Veritable 1000-Armed Kan'on & Chojo Kebutsu Artifacts of the Buddha!
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=This jutsu uses Sage Jutsu and Wood Style Ninjutsu to create a massive Buddha which assails the target with myriad strikes.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Forms a Rasengan out of the four arms generated by Kurama's chakra. Upon contact, enemies take damage and are sent flying. Also lowers the target's action speed and healing power.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=An all-out strike that puts the explosion from a Super-Mini Tailed Beast Bomb into Kurama's claw attack. Targets caught in the blast take damage and are rendered unable to use Substitution.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Use Kurama's chakra to recover all health and greatly increase physical abilities. Recovers ninjutsu cooldown time and grants reduced cooldowns for yourself and allies. Use the technique "Fake Fox Blast" with a command.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Forms the tail of Eight Tails using chakra to restrain and deal damage to an enemy. Temporarily stuns the target, disables the use of Substitutions, and increases damage taken upon being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A technique that blocks almost any enemy attack for a period of time before launching a counterattack that cuts the enemy with seven blades, knocks them back, and disables Substitution.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Jutsu that uses the Eight Tails' power to recover health and Ninjutsu cooldown, while boosting max health, Ninjutsu attack power, and defense. Reactivating it deals damage to surrounding enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Pulls the enemy forward with Universal Pull, then skewers them with a spear wreathed in black flame. The enemy is then sent flying and receives continuous burn damage. It also lowers the enemy's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Visual jutsu activated by the Rinnegan that lets the user switch with any space of their choosing. They can evade most attacks, and not get knocked back in some cases. Target an enemy to immediately switch places with them.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Jutsu that summons Perfect Susano'o, who uses Chidori with the black flames of Inferno Style: Flame Control. Can knock out an enemy in one hit. Defense reduced for enemies hit with black flame.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that generates a column of water centered on the caster that neutralizes enemy attacks. Allies can also enter the column. Enemies who touch the column when it appears are sent flying and take damage. Additional input transforms the water pillar and activates Water Style: Water Dragon Jutsu.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that expels globs of highly acidic fluid from the user's mouth, damaging enemies. The globs stay in the area for awhile and deal damage over time, lowering movement speed when touched.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that transforms chakra into a highly acidic mist and expels it from the user's mouth. Lowers the defense, movement speed, and deals continuous damage to those enemies caught within the mist.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The user is cloaked in a demonic aura and performs a charging upward strike. It also prevents flinching from attacks for a set period and recovers health by the amount of damage caused.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Perform a charging attack that uses clones to trap enemies in a watery cage. Deals continuous damage, empties the target's Substitution stock, and increases damage taken upon being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Blinds all enemies with mist, reducing their movement speed and disabling their Substitution Jutsu. Increases the user's attack power and ally movement speed while decreasing enemy lunge capability in close-range attacks. Additionally, Water Style ninjutsu and ninja tools have increased power for both user and allies.

column2: Earth Style: Super Weighted Boulder Jutsu
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Decreases movement speed, attack tracking ability, evasion distance, and lengthens Substitution and Ninjutsu cooldown times of all targets within range. Also decreases their Secret Technique gauge.

column2: Earth Style: Super Lightened Boulder Jutsu
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Boosts user's and ally's movement speed, attack tracking ability, evasion distance, and shortens Substitution and Ninjutsu cooldown times. Also charges the Secret Technique gauge.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Creates a huge cube in front of the user, knocking out any target it hits. It also nullifies any ninjutsu or projectiles it touches. When the cube is formed, it shoots out rocks that restrain anyone they hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Creates a stone clone, allowing the user to switch out and escape from attacks. Temporarily increases movement speed upon escape. Enemies that come into contact with the clone have their guard durability drastically reduced.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Launches ice needles at enemies. Targets are frozen upon impact, extending their ninjutsu and Substitution cooldown time and increasing damage taken upon being attacked. Boosts the user's evasion during activation.

column2: Hidden Jutsu: A Thousand Needles of Death
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Forms a pool of water around the user's feet that traps enemies, before piercing them with shards of ice. Seals ninjutsu on hit, and increases damage taken by affected targets when first attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Surrounds the target with ice mirrors before launching a series of attacks, moving at high speeds between the mirrors. Deals damage to targets hit and reduces the healing they receive.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summons ice crystals with clones inside that the user can trade places with to escape attacks, freezing enemies and extending their Ninjutsu and Substitution cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Release a war cry, temporarily paralyzing surrounding enemies. Cures the user and all nearby allies of their status ailments and boosts close-range attack power.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Charge forward and deliver a flying kick, knocking back the target and dealing damage. Boosts the user's defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Ultimate secret technique to open all 8 gates. Get huge power at great cost. While active, "Evening Elephant" can be used up to 5 times. "Night Guy" can also be used, but you won't be able to fight afterwards.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes mental energy to attack enemies. Temporarily paralyzes targets on hit, reduces their Secret Technique gauge, and increases damage taken upon being attacked. While active, the user cannot move either. Additional inputs deal explosive damage to affected targets.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Continuously recovers the health of the user and all allies for a certain period of time. However, since the user cannot move while active, the technique can be canceled at any time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes the Mind Transmission Jutsu, which temporarily paralyzes enemies on hit and increases damage taken upon being attacked. Repeated inputs deal explosive damage and reduce the target's Secret Technique gauge.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The user charges toward a target and pierces them with a black electrical charge, causing damage and disabling Substitution.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that infuses the user's arm with the power of Kamui. Charging forward, piercing their target with a powerful thrust, which deals damage and lowers their defense. The attack nullifies enemy attacks while active.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Visual Jutsu that utilizes the Mangekyo Sharingan to nullify enemy attacks as long as you aren't attacking. Additionally, it increases attack power and movement speed, reduces Ninjutsu cooldown, and reveals invisible enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=This jutsu launches shuriken infused with Kamui in four directions from Perfect Susano'o. Targets within range are sent to an alternate dimension, knocking them out and making it impossible for them to be revived.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A technique that gathers chakra in the user's body who then releases it with both hands. Cures status ailments, allows the user to escape from most attacks, and target cannot use Substitution. Temporarily boosts defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Land a huge palm blow to your opponent's chest, blasting out enough Chakra to pierce through them. It deals damage to enemies in a straight line, disabling Substitution and reducing the Secret Technique gauge.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes a savage combination of attacks on the enemies within the user's Byakugan line of sight, which mimics the 8 Trigrams' range. Opponents hit by this take damage, become unable to perform substitutions, and have their Secret Technique gauge reduced.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Charge at the enemy and perform a combo with a flaming dagger. With every strike, you teleport behind the enemy and perform an additional attack to the rear. First hit will make target unable to use Substitutions.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Throw a Demon Wind Shuriken and input a command to pull it toward you. Increases movement speed, attack tracking ability, and evasion range. It also reveals invisible enemies, seals the target's Ninjutsu, and disables Substitution.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Genjutsu that utilizes the Mangekyo Sharingan. Allies are granted the ability to use the Sharingan for protection against Ninjutsu and to reveal invisible enemies. With additional input, activate Koto Amatsukami Zanko, confusing enemies and removing beneficial status effects.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Use Teleportation Jutsu to escape the enemy's attack. After performing, you will temporarily have increased movement speed, attack tracking ability, and evasion range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that uses orbs to grant invulnerability. Enemies that come into contact with these orbs take damage, and their attacks are nullified. The user can move while defending. Additional input turns the orbs into projectiles that, on hit, seal the target's Ninjutsu and Ninja Tools.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A jutsu that uses the power of the Six Paths. Unconscious allies in its area are revived, their defense increased, and their health restored along with other allies in the area. When used, it sends enemies in the area flying back.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The user enters the Sage of the Six Paths Mode, revives unconscious allies, recovers Ninjutsu cooldown, and heals them gradually for some time. Two Massive Rasen Shuriken are conjured and fired at the enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Creates corporeal clones of the user. After getting behind the enemy, the user creates another three clones in front of them. The jutsu has a long cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes a surprise attack using the Shadow Clone Jutsu. Restrains the enemy using Lightning Style ninjutsu if the user is attacked while signing, increasing damage taken upon being attacked. The user then appears behind the target, before charging at them. Can move freely while signing.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes Water Style: Tidal Wave to stun enemies and disable the use of Substitutions. Affected targets take additional damage upon being attacked. Additional input activates Lightning Style: Thunderclap Arrow, which deals damage to targets hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=User's attack, defense, and Secret Technique gauge increased. Allies in range made invincible and cured of status ailments. Enemy movement speed, Secret Technique gauge reduced, Substitution Ninjutsu stock reset.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Massive Rasengan fueled by the hopes and dreams of the Uzumaki family. Uses shadow clones filled with Uzumaki power and dreams to create a Massive Rasengan with wide range and high damage.

column2: Strength of a Hundred: Flower Cannon
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Utilizes the 100 Healings Jutsu to heal the user and lend strength to allies. Boosts ally attack power and ninjutsu resistance. Also reduces their ninjutsu cooldown and recovers their health over time.

column2: Strength of a Hundred: Hard Light
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Utilizes the 100 Healings Jutsu to fortify the user's body and gain strength. Boosts defense, close-range attack power, and recovers health if used just before damage. Can be activated while being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Boost's the user's attack power, movement speed, attack speed, Chakra Jump charge speed, and attack tracking ability. Also recovers allies' health over time. Input an additional command to activate Cherry Blossom Hurricane and blow away enemies in range.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summons a chameleon and grants the user invisibility, increases attack power, prevents enemies from locking on, and ensures the user takes 0 damage. The effect ends upon attacking or being attacked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Jutsu that transforms the user and enables Shura Attack mode for a certain period of time. This changes the user's Ninjutsu to "Arm Cannon" and "Fire Arrow Head," which can be fired in rapid succession. The lower the user's health, the more damage "Arm Cannon" deals.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Summons a Gedo Statue that fires a dragon. Targets hit by the dragon fall unconscious, but the user's spirit is drained, rendering them stunned, lowering their health by half, and disabling them from using ninjutsu or substitution for a while.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Genjutsu that restrains a single enemy and stabs them with a sword, dealing damage. It also reduces enemy attack power, attack speed, and attack-tracking speed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Manifests Susano'o and hurls beads at enemies. Hitting a target results in a blast that engulfs all enemies in the surrounding area, inflicting damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Resets enemies' beneficial effects, position, cooldown gauges except Secret Technique. Also resets allies' harmful effects. Additional input breaks loop, restrains enemies, revives allies, seals user's ninjutsu for a period.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Switches the user with a clone and allows them to escape from enemy attacks. The clone will then explode, dealing damage to enemies within a wide area. This Jutsu has a long cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Allows the user to swap positions with their kunai either a certain amount of time from being thrown, or with additional input. Follow up with Chidori and rush forward to damage the enemy.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Defensive Jutsu that clads the user in Susano'o. Auto-guards for a certain period of time, doesn't lose durability, can't be broken by enemies, and allows the user to deal damage while in a guarded state.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Manifests Susano'o with the power of the Tailed Beast and fires an arrow. Hitting results in a blast that knocks out all enemies within range. In addition, lightning strikes the point of impact, dealing damage. Also, the user's ninjutsu and substitution stock are replenished.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Jutsu that uses Rinne Sharingan to teleport and avoid enemy attacks. After use, Ninjutsu cooldown time reduced, and user is invulnerable to attack for a period of time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Holding the button disables ninja tools and ninjutsu which channel chakra. Any targets hit will have ninjutsu sealed, ST gauge reduced, and attack power reduced for a short time. Release to reduce user N-cooldown and increase ST gauge. Ninjutsu attacks also hit harder.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Transforms the user's right arm into a shield, before launching a tackle attack that disables the use of substitutions. During the tackle, certain attacks no longer knock the user back. After the tackle, the user can perform follow-up attacks via additional inputs, or move freely if they choose.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The user rushes an enemy and strikes with a single fist while using a Ninja Tool to pierce the enemy. These attacks are followed by a Karma linchpin that explodes and inflicts massive damage over a wide area.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Uses Taijutsu to instantly escape from an enemy attack. In addition, using both the Scientific Ninja Tool's and their own innate regenerative abilities, users recover health and remove status ailments.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Launches a karma lynchpin-infused Rasengan. If the jutsu lands, Kawaki will use his chakra to recover the user's Ninjutsu cooldown time and enlarge the Rasengan, dealing heavy damage over a wide range.

column2: Sage Art: Shadow Style: Thunder Blast
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Lightning surges from the user's hands to restrain opponents. Hold down the button to charge and increase the range of the lightning. More charged variations disable Substitution and reduce defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Clones appear from Limbo, the unseen world, to attack and restrain nearby opponents. Clones disappear after a certain amount of time. Can be activated during an enemy's attack. Additional input will cause clones to rush towards the target.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Genjutsu uses the moon and Rinne Sharingan to restrain enemies. Added input for 'Divine Deep Forest Emergence' to absorb health, Ninjutsu & Substitution cooldown, and Secret Technique gauge from nearby enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Creates four tornadoes that hone in on nearby targets. Targets take damage, have reduced healing power, and are blasted into the air. The user and their allies can also use the tornadoes to launch themselves into the air.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Summons Kamatari, who then wraps himself around the opponent like a whirlwind. While Kamatari is present, the target takes continuous damage and can no longer receive some beneficial or recovery effects. After some time, Kamatari rips through the target.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Generates an enormous tornado which continuously pulls in enemies. Those that get caught inside take damage, have reduced healing power, and remain trapped for a set duration. Multiple enemies can be pulled in at once.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=User expels hot ash from their mouth. The ash persists as smoke, flinching targets it touches and inhibiting vision. Additional input or flames from a Fire Style attack will cause it to explode, inflicting continuous burn damage on enemies caught in the blast.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A Jutsu that launches a clone into the air, continuously raining down flame bombs. Targets hit by the flame bombs take damage. Forces enemies to lock on to the clone instead of the user, and the user becomes invulnerable for a brief period.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summons Enra to wrap around enemies within range. Inflicts continuous damage, reduces movement speed, and disables Substitutions. Additional input activates "Combined Sealing: Monkey-Sun Suppression", knocking enemies out and increasing their respawn time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Rush down the enemy with a fist clad in Baryon Mode chakra. Deals damage, reduces Secret Technique gauge, and extends the amount of time Substitutions are disabled for the enemy each time the fist connects.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Pierce the enemy with a mighty tail of chakra. While active, automatically attacks enemies within range, dealing damage and reducing Secret Technique gauge. However, the user will be unable to use Ninja Tools.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Fully recovers Health, Ninjutsu Cooldown. Increases physical abilities and alters Ninjutsu. Target's Secret Technique gauge is reduced, and damage is incurred even if they block. However, also drains health and disables Ninja Tools for the user.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Enter Baryon Mode, immediately escaping from enemy attacks. Then perform a counterattack, dealing damage and reducing Secret Technique gauge of hit targets. This Jutsu has a long cooldown time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=The user shrinks enemy projectiles instantly, nullifying them and revealing invisible enemies. Transportation Ninjutsu is activated for the user when hit by enemy close-range attacks or Ninjutsu. Additional input generates a column at the enemy's location, causing damage, reducing speed, and increasing Ninjutsu and Substitution Cooldown.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Etch "Karma" onto a single enemy, dealing damage. Additional input grants the user increased attack speed and attack tracking speed. User also automatically gets behind target and deals damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summon gigantic boulders to rain down on the enemy. Deals damage to all enemies within range, temporarily blocking chakra detection, disabling lock-on and status checks, and knocking them away on impact.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Approach the enemy with a Flying Raijin Jutsu and unleash a Rasengan infused with Yin-Yang Nine Tails Chakra. Increases the movement speed of all allies and recovers their health and ninjutsu cooldown.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A surprise attack that utilizes the Flying Raijin Jutsu. The user throws a kunai at a target. If it hits, they will teleport close to the target and unleash a combo attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Uses Flying Raijin to create a barrier, rendering enemy Flying Tool Attacks periodically ineffective. Allies who step inside the barrier gain a boost to close-range attacks.

column2: Flying Raijin: Jiku Shippu Senko Rennodan Zeroshiki
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Combines Shadow Clone Jutsu and Flying Raijin Jutsu. The user throws a kunai at a target, and if it hits, they will Swift Step toward the target and launch a combo attack plus Rasengan.

column2: The Piercing One-Fingered Thrust of Hell
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes a sharp one-fingered thrust of Lightning Style chakra which lowers enemy defense. Press and hold to charge, then rush toward the enemy at ultra high speed to unleash an unblockable attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Commands the Truthseeker Orbs to unleash a beam forwards. Deals damage to all targets hit. Hold the button to increase the uptime of the beam. The beam's direction can be controlled.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Commands the Truthseeker Orbs to erupt in hellfire. The flames persist at the location for a set duration, damaging enemies. Disables the use of Substitutions on hit.

column2: Sage of Six Path's Divine Blade: The Nunoboko
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Attack enemies with the Sage of the Six Paths's blade. Unleashes an extremely long-range attack that pierces walls, inflicting heavy damage to enemies and resets their substitution and ninjutsu stocks.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes a surprise attack that strikes from an enemy's blind spot with the Flying Raijin Jutsu. The user throws a kunai and, after moving, performs a lunging slash. Deals additional damage to enemies that aren't targeting the user and disables use of Substitutions.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Release chakra from the palm to unleash an onslaught of giant fists. Landing this attack will allow you to extend its duration by mashing additional inputs.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Launches a bone of ash from the user's palm to assail an opponent. Targets hit take continuous damage. If this attack misses, it phases into another dimension, reappearing to seek the target again. This effect can only activate once.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Teleports both the user and nearby enemies into a separate dimension, which can be toggled between ice or lava. While active, the user's defense and speed is increased, certain attacks will no longer knock them back, and their normal attack is replaced with a special attack that matches the current dimension.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Travel through a rift in space-time to evade an enemy attack. Temporarily allows the user to traverse the field in a separate dimension, before reemerging in a parallel location. The timing of this effect can be controlled.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=One of the Second Mizukage's favorite Water Clone Jutsu techniques. Produces a clone that tracks its target, exploding in a cloud of vapor when close. Up to 4 clones are created in succession, each charging and exploding near the target. Decreases user defense and movement speed while active.

column2: Particle Style: Atomic Dismantling Jutsu - Pillar
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Continuously emit chakra in the shape of a pillar, disintegrating all matter on contact. There will be a brief window after activation in which to aim the attack. Enemies hit are dealt damage, and some beneficial status effects are removed.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Summon Itachi to attack with Susano'o and Amaterasu in tandem. Susano'o performs a long-range attack, creating an explosion at the point of impact. Amaterasu remains afterward, damaging and burning targets hit, and reducing their defense.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Stab a foe with a sudden strike. Charge and thrust at an enemy, before following up with an overhead attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Launch two types of Rasengan of varying size to deal damage. Pulls in targets within a certain range on hit. Holding the input will charge the attack, dealing more damage and increasing its size. Charging will increase the pull's radius and extends the pull's duration.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleash the power of Karma to recover all health and greatly increase physical abilities. Recovers the user's ninjutsu cooldown time, grants reduced cooldowns and boosts ninjutsu attack power. Also reduces ninja tool cooldown and boosts ninja tool attack power. Additional input moves you directly above the target and activates "Massive Rasengan."

column2: Magnet Style: Gold Dust Great Burial
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Forms a wall of gold dust in front of the user. Inflicts damage to targets standing where it is created. Additional input causes the wall to advance forward, inflicting damage to targets it touches. At the end of its path, it falls over to deal additional damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes a destructive wave of sand that deals damage, and slows those in its trail. An additional input after the wave breaks will damage and knock back all enemies still trapped in the sand.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Creates a hand from sand that chases and restrains enemies. An additional input upon capturing an enemy will perform Sand Burial, dealing damage. Sand Burial gains more damage with each consecutive use, but resets when the user is knocked out.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Forcefully puts the user to sleep to merge with Shukaku. The user temporarily becomes Shukaku, replacing their normal attacks and ninjutsu with special attacks. However, their movement is restricted to certain areas for the duration of the transformation.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summons a giant wooden golem using Wood Style that slams the ground, damaging any targets caught in the attack with an additional powerful punch. The user then temporarily equips a Wood Dragon on their back and has their normal attacks replaced with special attacks.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Manipulates the puppet to continually summon arms from within its arm. Upon activation, allows for free control of the puppet. Additional input will cause the puppet to attack with its arms, inflicting damage and poison and disabling use of Substitution for a short period. Also reduces the healing the target receives.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Scatters iron sand, turning it into a myriad of thorns with a repelling magnetic field. Deals damage, inflicts poison, and reduces the healing received. Also creates a cluster of iron sand above where the jutsu lands. Additional input causes a thorn to extend downward from the clusters, causing the same effects as the initial attack. Targets in the center of the thorn's radius receive greater damage.

column2: Secret Red Move: Performance of a Hundred Puppets
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Connects puppets directly to one's core, allowing for direct control over one hundred puppets. The puppets rush down the target, inflicting damage and poison, as well as reducing the healing they receive.
category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Pulls a shrunken stake from another dimension and throws it, dropping a large boulder on those pierced by the initial attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Shrinks the user, allowing them to launch a surprise attack on their foes. If activated in the air, the user attacks with a Scientific Ninja Tool from above. If activated on the ground, the user burrows and attacks from below. The user is invulnerable while shrunken.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Fully restores the user's health and drastically boosts their physical prowess by releasing the evolved Karma's power. Also activates Sukunahikona, negating all projectiles other than Secret Techniques, and changing the user's Strong Attack to a special attack that drops a large boulder on their foe. Additional inputs will release fireballs, and enemies hit by them are chased and struck by Scientific Ninja Tool arms.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Unleashes the chakra of Two Tails, transforming the user into a Tailed Beast. The user is enveloped in fire, and leaps up to perform a down thrust attack that releases explosive flames.
