category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Channels chakra through Susano'o and discharges it as countless Senbon. When activated, the user is clad in Susano'o, blocking certain enemy attacks. Reactivation will fire needles at the target that deal damage based on how much damage has been blocked.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Projects horrifying illusions using "Sharingan" which paralyze the target. Grants Sharingan Mode to the user and nearby allies when activated, revealing invisible enemies and blocking most attacks. After an attack has been blocked, phantasms are launched at the attacking enemy, restraining and damaging all who come into contact.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Summons Perfect Susano'o who attacks enemies from the air. When activated, the user flies into the air and chooses the attack site. When activated again, Susano'o targets the attack site and knocks out the target. Beams of light also appear in the area, damaging enemies upon contact.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Unleash Six Tails chakra and transform, gaining the ability to attack with bubbles. Fires bubbles that explode on contact with nearby objects, before targeting the enemy with a massive bubble. While slow, these bubbles will continue to pursue and attack enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A toad trained to support ninjas. The summoner can jump on and ride the toad freely. The rider is immune to flinches from certain attacks, and the toad automatically attacks nearby enemies with its tongue. Deactivation will cause the toad to drop on to the target's head and deal damage. This toad deals more damage to enemies than other Ninja Toads.

The rider is immune to flinches from certain attacks, and the toad automatically attacks nearby enemies with its tongue. Deactivation will cause the toad to drop on to the target's head and deal damage. While riding: Rider's health will be restored.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A combo attack that combines Shadow Clone and Rasengan. When activated, the user launches a clone attack, then attacks anyone hit with Rasengan. User is immune to flinches caused by certain attacks when attacking.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=The user transforms into a Demon Wind Shuriken which a Shadow Clone can throw to attack. When activated, the user can control the shuriken freely, dealing damage to anything it touches. Additional input will dispel the transformation and the user will perform a flying kick at the opponent, dealing damage on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=By releasing the rampaging Nine Tails' power, the user's health is fully restored and physical abilities are greatly boosted. While active, normal attacks and ninjutsu become unique attacks, and Ninja Tools cannot be used. Additional input will unleash a roar that causes nearby enemies to flinch, followed by a giant Rasengan attack. While equipped, when the user or allies are knocked out, the secret technique gauge will fill significantly.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Kawarimi;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Releases the Chakra of Nine Tails to instantly escape from an enemy attack. After escaping, the user is temporarily immune to flinches caused by certain attacks while wrapped in Nine Tails Chakra.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Transforms the user by releasing Three Tails Chakra, before unleashing a shockwave. Targets hit are sent flying a great distance and take damage, with those closest to the center of the shockwave taking more damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Release the Seven Tails chakra to transform and unleash a raging tornado. The tornado travels in a straight line and damages its target. After the attack, a soothing wind blows on the user and all allies, boosting their physical abilities. Knocking enemies out extends the wind's duration.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Draws out the Curse Mark's power to thrust at your enemies using chakra. The user charges at the target and performs a ferocious attack, reducing cooldown time on hit.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Uses a wire to shoot flames at ultra high speed. The user throws a shuriken with a wire attached, restraining the target if it lands. Flames then shoot down toward the target, dealing damage and inflicting burn. The wire remains in place, reducing the movement speed and evasion range of nearby enemies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=By releasing the Curse Mark's power, the user's health is fully restored and physical abilities are greatly boosted. While active, strong attacks and ninjutsu become unique attacks, and an additional input will activate a terrific chakra Chidori attack. While equipped, the secret technique gauge will fill significantly when the user knocks enemies out.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Summon Sasori to create a C2 Dragon covered in Iron Sand to attack with. The C2 Dragon attacks by crushing enemies from above, after which it causes a large explosion.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Summon Deidara to mold Iron Sand-covered detonating clay and attack with it. You may move freely after activating this secret technique and, for a limited time, direct repeated detonating clay attacks at the enemy. In addition, you boost nearby allies' physical abilities via Chakra Threads.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Spin around, swinging your weapon at everything within reach. Move freely while holding the Ninjutsu button down after activation to continue spinning. Recover health equal to the amount of damage you deal.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Rush forward and attack with your weapon. Rush toward the target and perform a combo on the target once you are close. Your physical abilities increase with each hit landed. This boost ends once you are knocked out.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=A blood curse that causes the target to take the same damage as you. After activating, you cannot be knocked out except by certain attacks, such as Sealing Jutsu, and you gain access to a special ninja tool. If you steal your target's blood by hitting with a close-range attack, you can perform a ritual with an additional input in which you impale yourself and cause the target to be knocked out. If you are attacked during the ritual, the damage is also inflicted on the target whose blood was stolen.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Snake trained to support Ninjas. The summoner can freely ride underground inside the snake's mouth. Pressing the jump button will unleash a gale bullet to damage the opponent. Ending the technique will cause the Ninja Snake to burst out of the ground and attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Snake trained to support ninjas. The summoner can freely ride underground inside the snake's mouth. There is a health recovery effect while riding. Pressing the jump button will unleash a snake bullet to damage the opponent. Ending the technique will cause the Ninja Snake to burst out of the ground and attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Snake trained to support Ninjas. The summoner can freely ride underground inside the snake's mouth. There is a ninjutsu cooldown reduction effect while riding. Pressing the jump button will unleash poison fog to damage the opponent. Ending the technique will cause the Ninja Snake to burst out of the ground and attack.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Fuses fission beings created with Earth Grudge together to unleash hellfire. Creates a Fire Style-wielding fission being, and additional input will create a Wind Style-wielding fission being. If these beings are created close together, they will fuse into a fission being that unleashes intense flame. Fission beings automatically attack nearby opponents and disappear after a set amount of time or after inflicting a certain amount of damage.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Heal;group=DLC;desc=Uses Earth Grudge tentacles to suture and heal wounds. Heals nearby allies and temporarily allows them to recover health when they hit with a normal attack or KO an opponent. If an ally is defeated while this ninjutsu is active, that ally will enter a preservation state in which temporary health recovers to maximum and ongoing severe damage is inflicted. This preservation state ends if an opponent is knocked out.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Fuses the user's body with a fission being to perform powerful ranged attacks. When activated, the user fuses with a fission being and lunges. If this lunge hits, the opponent is launched and a follow-up ranged attack is performed, after which the user's normal attacks temporarily change to special attacks that make use of Earth Grudge's long tentacles.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Tortoise trained to support Ninjas. The user can ride the tortoise through the air, setting the direction by adjusting the camera angle. Deals damage to targets that it touches, and the rider is immune to flinches caused by most attacks. The rider will jump off if the jutsu is canceled. Press the jump button to use the turtle as a springboard. When the jutsu ends, the tortoise falls directly to the ground, dealing damage to targets at the point of impact and leaving lava behind that damages those who touch it.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Tortoise trained to support Ninjas. The user can ride the tortoise through the air, setting the direction by adjusting the camera angle. Rider's health will be restored, and the rider is immune to flinches caused by most attacks. The rider will jump off if the jutsu is canceled. Press the jump button to use the turtle as a springboard. When the jutsu ends, the tortoise heals all nearby allies.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=A Ninja Tortoise trained to support Ninjas. The user can ride the tortoise through the air, setting the direction by adjusting the camera angle. Ninja tool cooldown time is reduced, and the rider is immune to flinches caused by most attacks. The rider will jump off if the jutsu is canceled. Press the jump button to use the turtle as a springboard. When the jutsu ends, the tortoise charges at opponents and deals damage. If it hits a wall during this charge, it bounces off and continues the attack for a while.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Don a rock in the likeness of a monkey to attack. Press and hold to charge after activating to grow larger over time. After charging, you enter a lunging state and can move freely. An additional input will punch. Lunge speed and punch power increase with flight time. Defense is increased while in effect, and the user will not be knocked down by most attacks.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Ranged;group=DLC;desc=Control a beast in the likeness of a dog to attack. Let the beast out in a straight line and deal damage to everything it touches. After being let out, the beast becomes terrain that can move and influence allies and foes. When allies (including the user) approach this terrain, they receive movement speed: up, but when enemies approach, it explodes and deals damage to them. Press and hold the Ninjutsu button to control the direction in which the beast is released.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Transform your body and fire a massive chakra orb by consuming "Pills." After the attack, your physical abilities are enhanced, healing received is reduced, and substitution cooldown is increased. In addition, your ninja tool becomes able to absorb any chakra that enemies use for techniques to slightly increase your physical abilities each time.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Ninja Cats trained to support Ninjas. Summon two Ninja Cats. One of them opens a scroll, leaving items that grant various effects and can be picked up by anyone. The other supports the user by throwing shuriken. Touching a Ninja Cat will cause it to jump on your shoulder and lend support from there. The scroll tends to drop items that increase attack power.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Ninja Cats trained to support Ninjas. Summon two Ninja Cats. One of them opens a scroll, leaving items that grant various effects and can be picked up by anyone. The other supports the user by throwing shuriken. Touching a Ninja Cat will cause it to jump on your shoulder and lend support from there. Healer Ninja Cats tend to drop items that increase health recovery and defense.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Summon;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Ninja Cats trained to support Ninjas. Summon two Ninja Cats. One of them opens a scroll, leaving items that grant various effects and can be picked up by anyone. The other supports the user by throwing shuriken. Touching a Ninja Cat will cause it to jump on your shoulder and lend support from there. Supplier Ninja Cats tend to drop items that decrease ninja tool and ninjutsu cooldown times.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=A dance that causes bones throughout the body to protrude, slashing any enemy they touch. This blocks most enemy attacks temporarily before launching a counterattack. After blocking an attack or with an additional input, lunge at the enemy and fire bones. The user is invulnerable if this is triggered with a block.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Melee;group=DLC;desc=Attack using a whip-like spine and a massive bone spear. Can be activated in a specified direction to swing the spine there, causing area damage. When activated without specifying a direction, perform a charging attack with the bone spear.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_FinishMove;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Thrust massive bones from the ground to attack. Sends enemies in range into the air, before the user performs a follow-up attack with a bone spear.

column2: Sage Art: Bath of Boiling Oil
column8: category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Coordinate with Fukasaku and Shima to simultaneously unleash fire, wind, and oil. The oil damages enemies, and any enemies who make contact with the trail of oil have their movement speed reduced and cause an area to form that damages those caught within it.

category=ENN_NinjaSkillCategory_Normal;type=Technical;group=DLC;desc=Release ultrasonic waves from the mouth to immobilize the opponent. Upon activation, Fukasaku and Shima are summoned, and for a certain period, the user's ninjutsu changes to specialized attacks from the Sage Toads. category=ShortSword;desc=A weapon based on the magical sword of Orochimaru. The real Kusanagi Sword is a thin blade, but its magic gives it frightening power and durability.

category=Katana;desc=A weapon based on the ninja sword of Tobirama Senju, the Second Hokage and the First Hokage's younger brother. Channeling Water Style chakra into the blade allows it to utilize its full potential, but few ninja have ever mastered it.
category=Katana;desc=A bottle filled with Tsunade's favorite sake. It's highly durable, so it can also be used as a weapon. Minors aren't allowed to drink it, of course.
category=LongSword;desc=A weapon based on the long sword of Hashirama Senju, the First Hokage. The real blade was later used in the battle against Madara Uchiha.

category=LongSword;desc=A weapon based on the fan of Madara Uchiha. The real fan, which is passed down by the leaders of the clan, is a powerful treasure which can deflect any attack.
category=LongSword;desc=A weapon based on the staff of Obito Uchiha, who became the Ten Tails Jinchuriki. It has a deep, dark color, as if it can swallow up all light.

category=ShortSword;desc=A specially crafted Kunai used by Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage. This weapon has gone on to become a symbol of Minato, and can be seen as the starting point for the Transportation Ninjutsu that he excelled at.
category=LongSword;desc=A weapon based on Hiruzen Sarutobi's staff. The Monkey King Enma transforms into the real Adamantine Staff, which has been used by Hiruzen to save countless ninja lives.

category=LongSword;desc=Originally used to hit a shuttlecock, this paddle was adopted by ninja for its robustness and use in warding off demons. Before long, a large version became the must-have defensive weapon.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=Gloves that capture the image of rabbits dashing through the snow. Once their beady, red eyes lock on to their prey, you know it's game over. What follows is an overpowering flurry of lightning-fast blows. These are cute, but deadly weapons.
category=LongSword;desc=One of the seven special ninja blades from Hidden Mist Village. When its blade tastes blood, it revives itself.
category=ShortSword

category=ShortSword;desc=A small candy-apple-shaped mallet made for the Ninja World Face-Off. This phenomenal weapon shows how dedicated Hidden Leaf Village is to all sorts of research, not just scientific ones.

category=LongSword;desc=A sword in the shape of a giant chocolate-covered banana, created for the Ninja World Face-Off. It demonstrates the Hidden Leaf Village's passion and skill for developing only the best weapons.

category=Katana;desc=At just 10 years old, Itachi Uchiha became a Chunin; by 13 he was leader of the Anbu in Hidden Leaf Village. This weapon's design is based on his favorite blade while he worked for the Anbu.

category=LongSword;desc=Modeled after the Executioner's Blade, one of the weapons wielded by the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist. The real Executioner's Blade can absorb iron from blood to regenerate itself, and has done so across many battlefields.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=Asuma Sarutobi, a Jonin from Hidden Leaf Village who lead Team 10. This weapon is based on the special one he used.
category=ShortSword
category=LongSword;desc=Originally made for flying to the spooky annual banquet, this item was later retrofitted into something more practical; a weapon. Clean up all your enemies in one fell sweep!
category=MartialWeapon;desc=Don't be fooled by the cute ribbons! It's rumored that any ninja who wear these claws become possessed, driven to wander in search of blood night after night.
category=ShortSword

category=Katana;desc=A replica of the Demon Flute used by Sound Four member Tayuya. Though it unfortunately cannot control spirits or cast genjutsu like the original, it is fairly effective as a bludgeoning weapon.
category=Katana;desc=A replica of the sword made from the Sound Four leader Kimimaro's bones. While not as robust as the original, its high durability makes it the perfect weapon for Heal Types.

category=LongSword;desc=One of the seven legendary ninja blades passed down in Hidden Mist Village. This special sword has a will of its own and can absorb an opponent's chakra. Killer Bee became its new owner after it took an interest in him.
category=ShortSword
category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of Sasuke Uchiha's favorite ninja blade. This sharp sword was forged with the use of Chidori in mind. Even with one arm, Sasuke's skills with it haven't dulled.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A blade of ice which cuts through the silence of a snowy night. It's said that a ninja caught in this claw's grasp will hear the cold sound of holy bells by their pillow and fall into eternal slumber...
category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the weapon used by the hero of the film "Legend of the Magic-Eyed Ninja Kagemasa!" A must-have item if you call yourself a Kagemasa fan.

category=LongSword;desc=An auspicious weapon suitable for the start of battle on New Year's. It's said that in the hands of a master, this weapon can repaint an unfavorable battle with just a single bewitching stroke.

category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of the glowing white chakra blade wielded by the Sixth Hokage in his younger years. As though clad in lightning, his father's beloved blade carries the feelings of the Hatake family.
category=LongSword;desc=A special weapon for Valentine's Day that strikes an intense blow with its sweet candy appearance. Toasting it under a hot flame increases tastiness and power! Eat up!
category=LongSword;desc=A replica made to imitate the Twinsword: Hiramekarei after its blade changed. The original Hiramekarei releases stored chakra all at once, splitting the sword into two blades.

category=Katana;desc=A special sword clad in the chakra of the Nine Tails. Fills you with power when held. During the Fourth Great Ninja War, it appeared in someone's dream while under the influence of the Infinite Tsukuyomi...apparently.
category=Katana;desc=A replica of the preferred ninja blade used by the Sixth Hokage in the Anbu era. Impressively sharp and a perfect fit for the Cold-Blooded Kakashi.
category=ShortSword;desc=A special ninja sword forged for Uchiha (Armored Vers.). Exceptionally sharp.
category=Katana;desc=A special naginata forged for Sakura (Armored Vers.). Extremely comfortable to use.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica based on one of the legendary seven blades of the Village Hidden in The Mist. The user can unravel and wind the scroll to replenish the paper bombs that make up its blade.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool that can be attached to both hands. Using this tool's sharp chakra claws, the user can land multiple swift attacks on targets, making it ideal for relentlessly cutting down foes.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=Scientific Ninja Tool shaped like Ninja Knuckle Knives. When attacking, the user's chakra is used to stretch the blade to cut into enemies even if they attempt to evade the strike.

category=ShortSword;desc=A replica based on one of the legendary seven blades of the Hidden Mist. In a period of unrest, a next generation ninja discharged the lightning covering the blade and sent it flying.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool that can be attached to both hands. The tool has sharp chakra claws that can hold the target to keep attacking. A difficult weapon that can only be wielded by a veteran user.

category=LongSword;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool and sword with a blade at either end. Imbued with chakra, the blades can spin and slice through hordes of enemies. Wielding this tool requires both experience and arduous training.
category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of a katana used by Shisui Uchiha. Perfect for Swift Shisui, it allows you to cut down the enemy with great speed.
category=ShortSword
category=ShortSword;desc=On a winter night, the sound of bells rings out on the battlefield. And it looks like they've brought presents! Happy Holidays!
category=Katana;desc=An auspicious weapon made in celebration of the new year. Opening your umbrella to strike at enemies resembles an elegant flower in bloom.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A special Valentine's weapon that looks chocolatey and sweet. Throw it at the person you like, and... Well, you never know. Maybe it will strike them in their heart.

category=Katana;desc=A replica based on one of the legendary seven blades of the Village Hidden in The Mist. Not only does the thread that runs through the blade stitch together enemies, it can also trap them, hang them up, and slice them.

column2: Scientific Ninja Tool "Double Moon Sword: Zero"
column8: category=LongSword;desc=A prototype of the Scientific Ninja Tool, "Double Moon Sword." Imbued with chakra on both ends, the blades can spin and slice enemies. This light, zero prototype allows for it to be brandished more nimbly.
category=LongSword;desc=A scythe whose blade was forged from chakra. This transformable Scientific Ninja Tool infuses the user's chakra into the blade, its added length allowing for long slices.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool worn on fists. Clenching it increases the user's power through chakra-born flames at their fists, which can blast away enemies in a single powerful hit. It also leaves a trail of flames in its wake, which is a pretty cool bonus!

category=Katana;desc=An umbrella-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. It can fire energy from its tip using the user's own chakra. Although difficult to handle, mastering this tool will make one's fighting unpredictable.

category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of the bubble pipe wielded by Utakata, the Six-Tailed Beast's Jinchuriki. As its name suggests, this pipe is able to summon countless bubbles capable of attacking opponents and bewildering them as illusions dance across their surface.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=For the ninja who prefers "Trick!" over "Treat!" This glove is handed out at a very special time of year. If your attack produces twinkles, that means the "Trick" was a success! Have fun!

category=LongSword;desc=A sickle with a blade forged from chakra. This Scientific Ninja Tool can be used as a doubled-bladed weapon or can be split into two sickles. Although difficult to master, once wielded correctly its near dance is beautiful as it is dangerous.

category=ShortSword;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of a Ninja Blade. This tool radiates with chakra when the user attacks, infusing the blade with blue lightning and freely firing bolts of lightning. Powerful swings flare electrical discharge, making this a pretty cool weapon!

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool worn on the fists. Clenching it creates purple-flamed chakra around the user's fists, which can blast away enemies in a single powerful hit. It also leaves a trail of purple flames in its wake, which is a pretty cool bonus!

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool worn on fists. Clenching it increases the user's speed through Lightning Style chakra at their fists, allowing users to toy with enemies using quick, sharp hits. Moving fast enough leaves lightning in its wake, which is a pretty cool bonus!

category=Katana;desc=An umbrella-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. Once imbued with the user's chakra, a blade forms at the umbrella's tip. Its lurid dance as it slashes and slices resembles the practiced routine of an acrobat.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A knuckle-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool modeled after those used by Kawaki. This Ninja Tool conforms to the user's fists as if it were an extension of their body. Pummel opponents with Taijutsu unlike any other!
category=Katana
category=Katana

category=Katana;desc=A reproduction of the staff used by Madara Uchiha upon obtaining the power of the Six Paths. As the staff is the Truthseeker Orbs in a different form, it can transform back into the Orbs and send them flying at any time, proving quite useful.
category=LongSword

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the enormous fan used by Temari. It holds the power of Wind Style, allowing you to knock opponents around, or attack them with wind. Modeled specially after her own Ninjutsu.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool worn on the fists. Accelerates the user's chakra flow when clenched, providing the power to pummel opponents with swift blows. Blue, shooting star-like trails follow your striking fists, which is a pretty cool bonus!

category=Katana;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool designed for the fists. Clenching it increases the user's power through chakra, which then unleashes an explosion that blasts away enemies with a single powerful hit. Attack opponents with an explosive rage, literally and figuratively!

category=LongSword;desc=A long-bladed Scientific Ninja Tool. The blades draw upon chakra through the handle, awakening its edge in a rush of lightning. In the hands of skilled swordsman, it produces deadly strikes.
category=LongSword

category=LongSword;desc=A weapon based on the staff wielded by Konohamaru Sarutobi. The actual staff was a transformation of the summoned Enra. In this way, the grandchildren of Hiruzen Sarutobi and the Monkey King Enma continued to work together just as their grandfathers did before them.

category=Katana;desc=A spear-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. While massive in appearance, it's wielded with ease through the infusion of chakra. The blade sings color as it arcs through the air, culminating in a display of crimson flowers.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool worn on the fists. Clenching it allows the user to build up Wind Style Chakra to create a tornado, then charge the opponent right after. Finish 'em off with a paw print for extra punch! Meow!

category=Katana;desc=The user attaches this Scientific Ninja Tool to their fist. It allows them to create a wave projectile attack using their Chakra. Overwhelm your enemies by using both direct attacks and Chakra wave projectiles.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of Ninja Knuckle Knives. Injecting Chakra at the time of attack causes the blades to extend and release a slash. A derivative of Scientific Ninja Tool "Red Flying Swallow", this tool is also designed to destroy opponents before they can escape.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=LongSword;desc=A long-bladed Scientific Ninja Tool. Wind Style Chakra allows the user to quickly unleash a barrage of slices on their opponent. To finish off, use chakra to spin the blade and cut down enemy defenses.

category=Katana;desc=Based on Tsubaki Kurogane's long sword. The original belonged to Mifune, the samurai General of the Land of Iron, before it was passed down to his disciple, Tsubaki. It's through his sword that his will lives on.

category=ShortSword;desc=A pair of Scientific Ninja Tools that shoot water bullets imbued with Water Style chakra. They are easily reloaded by channeling chakra. Shower your enemy with a torrent of water bullets and wash them away with a surprise attack!
category=LongSword

category=Katana;desc=A spear-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. Its wide tip is perfect for Taijutsu users that can utilize the weapon's reach. Its lightness harmonizes with Taijutsu and spear techniques beautifully, creating the illusion of a dance during attacks.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of Iwabee Yuino's weapon. The original was crafted to take advantage of Earth Style: Stone Brick, in which the user attaches a stone to the iron bar, transforming it into a hammer, spear, or the like. Although a replica, it performs as well as the original.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of a blade. Larger than a typical ninja sword, this weapon is ideal for strikes from a sheathed position. Tightly gripping its hilt causes it to become wreathed in Lightning Style chakra, shocking those the blade strikes.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=Katana;desc=A sword and shield set that comprises a single Scientific Ninja Tool. The shield can deflect enemies' thrown weapons and is paired with the sword to increase overall offensive capability. Incorporates much of the latest technology in both form and function.

category=ShortSword;desc=A pair of Scientific Ninja Tools based on the "Double Water Cannon." They have been modified to accept Fire Style chakra, which can be channeled into the weapon to shoot and reload. Unleash a flurry of fire bullets and incinerate your enemies!
category=MartialWeapon;desc=Modeled after Might Guy's weapon. Allows for new modes of attack when used in tandem with Taijutsu. A simple weapon with no gimmicks--perfect for masters of their art.
category=Katana;desc=A unique axe wielded by Sakura Haruno during a special festival. Deliver a heavy blow with a large axe that suits Sakura's incredible strength.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A unique spear wielded by Shisui Uchiha during a special festival. The blade is shaped like a drill, allowing it to be both swung and rotated to attack. It can also send needles flying from its tip. These features make it well suited to Shisui's tactics.
category=Katana

category=LongSword;desc=An axe-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool that is more than just a weapon to swing around. By channeling chakra into its edge, it becomes imbued with frost, causing pillars of ice to form when it strikes the ground.

category=LongSword;desc=This is an axe-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. Not only can it cut through enemies, it is designed to utilize Fire Style and Wind Style chakra to generate flames that burst forth like the roar of a great beast.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A blade-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. Despite its size, it is lightweight and can be easily handled with one hand. Its design allows the wielder to pass chakra through its length, awakening the body and allowing for a fighting style that employs sharp strikes at high speeds.

category=ShortSword;desc=Modeled after the weapon of Hanzo, the former leader of the Hidden Rain Village. He was himself made of- and therefore tolerant to- poison. He was particularly adept at fighting opponents with poison by coating it on his chain-sickle. This one is a replica, however, and does not include his favorite substance.

category=Katana;desc=A tonfa-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. In addition to the tonfa's inherent ability to overwhelm foes with a barrage of attacks, it has a mechanism to release a chakra shockwave from its tip, allowing the wielder to easily break the enemy's guard with double-impact strikes.
category=Katana

category=ShortSword;desc=A weapon modeled after Sasori's puppet of the Third Kazekage. Supplementing its limbs and various installed weaponry is its ability to manipulate iron sand, allowing the user to utilize the original human's abilities.

category=Katana;desc=A long, double-edged sword. This sword has been modified to be lighter, allowing for repeated strikes, while retaining the power its size brings. It can also release shockwaves by releasing a flow of chakra. Truly a masterwork item.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A kunai with designs hearkening back to Naruto Uzumaki, the Seventh Hokage whose body sealed the Tailed Beast Kurama within. This custom-made item reproduces the chakra of the Nine Tails, allowing for powerful claw-shaped chakra attacks to be used.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A copy of the gauntlets worn by Ay, the fourth Raikage. They carry a mechanism that turns a chakra flow into Lightning Style chakra. Wearing these will imbue you with the powers of the Raikage, allowing you to attack with the speed and power of lightning.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of Tekkou. Designed to enable the use of Chakra Threads for attacking, this tool can create threads of higher strength, allowing the user to overwhelm opponents with unique restraining attacks from afar.

category=ShortSword;desc=A sword with designs hearkening back to Sasuke Uchiha, the legendary hero known as the "Supporting Shadow." With this blade, Susano'o and Amaterasu can be recreated, allowing you to fight like Sasuke. Some say that the blade's power will make waves in the Ninja World League.

category=Katana;desc=A sword with designs hearkening back to Itachi Uchiha, the master ninja of the Uchiha Clan. With this sword, Itachi's techniques can be used, such as his bird clone jutsu Susano'o. The blade's wicked sharpness will strike the fear of darkness and the void into your enemies.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A sword made from a special metal that absorbs chakra, increasing its hardness. Once sealed away due to its propensity to indiscriminately absorb all nearby chakra, it is now usable thanks to a control device in the form of a mask—developed by the Scientific Ninja Tool Research Team. Its capabilities are unknown, but there is no question that its blade is incredibly sharp.

category=LongSword;desc=A spear with designs harkening to Gaara, the Fifth Kazekage whose body held the Tailed Beast Shukaku sealed within. It reproduces the wide-ranging attacks and sturdy defense using the sand in its gourd, allowing the wielder to use the same techniques as the Fifth Kazekage.
category=Katana

category=ShortSword;desc=A copy of a scroll used by Tenten. This weapon stays ahead of the curve if its user can control the numerous ninja tools and weapons sealed within. The maker herself, Tenten, said "I made sure tons of weapons are sealed in it. Make good use of them!"

category=ShortSword;desc=A weapon inspired by the Ninja Art: Super Beast Scroll. The special design reproduces the ability to draw images on a scroll and unleash various attacks by controlling monks and beasts. Toggle the image you want to draw with Strong Attack to switch between close and long-range attacks.

category=LongSword;desc=An equipment set that allows combat swords and scrolls to be wielded together. In addition to attacking with the sword, the user can also summon a bound toad. Overwhelm your enemies with the keen blade and the toad's support.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the club used by the Fourth Mizukage, Yagura. This weapon reproduces the various Water Style and coral attacks that Yagura was known for, making it a weapon that excels at attacking a wide area.

category=Katana;desc=Insects belonging to the Aburame Clan. Normally they must infest a host in order to be put to use, but by using chakra one can temporarily facilitate the exchange of information between various ninjas. Master this, and you'll be able to recreate the insect attacks of the Aburame Clan.

category=ShortSword;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of Tekkou. Channeling chakra through it generates Lightning Style chakra, enabling you to fire it from any distance. Unlike a traditional Scientific Ninja Tool, it is more of a chakra transformation device that allows for various Lightning Style ninjutsu.

category=Katana;desc=A replica of the Chakra weapons used by Momoshiki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki. In addition to being usable as a Chakra weapon, it also reproduces the ability to absorb Chakra and fire projectile attacks, allowing the user to handle a variety of situations.

category=LongSword;desc=A fan inspired by the legendary ninja, Madara Uchiha. This weapon reproduces the blasts of wind produced by the fan, as well as the wide-ranging attacks using Susano'o. Its numerous attacks will surely cause countless enemies to go blowing in the wind.
category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A pair of boot-type Scientific Ninja Tools. They activate the body from the legs, allowing for more agility than usual. This tool is great for taijitsu, especially for those that primarily make use of their legs.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of the Detonating Clay favored by Akatsuki member Deidara. Finding the artistic beauty he had been seeking in the Detonating Clay explosions, he created numerous pieces in pursuit of artistic perfection. Although a replica, this weapon has been designed to faithfully reproduce the unique form and destructive power of the originals.

category=LongSword;desc=A sword-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. Using Strong Attack, the user can switch between a form with a sword and Tekkou in each hand for rushing down enemies, and a form that combines them into one sword with superior reach and power. With its unique properties, this masterwork item allows its user to respond to various situations with a single swing.

category=ShortSword;desc=This staff made from the chakra-conductive wood of a sacred tree controls Fire and Lightning Style chakra to enhance long-range attacks. It is also sturdy enough to be used as a weapon.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool that reproduces the techniques used by Kawaki, a boy whose entire body is comprised of ninja tools. Various abilities have been replicated to measure his personal battle power, including his ability to absorb chakra with "Karma." Due to its complexity, it requires more skill and experience to use than other Scientific Ninja Tools.

category=Katana;desc=These Tekkou recreate the abilities and techniques of the renowned Hyuga Clan of Hidden Leaf Village. Primarily by supplementing chakra control to the optic nerve, they recreate the Hyuga Clan's Kekkei Genkai Byakugan and its associated Gentle Fist. The furious combos of this technique make it very clear why the Hyuga are the strongest in the Hidden Leaf Village.

category=Katana;desc=A replica of the wings worn by Fuu, Jinchuriki of the seven-tailed beast. Through Seven Tails' chakra, these wings sprout from her back, allowing her to fight from the sky. By donning this weapon, the user can replicate her agile shock attacks.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A blade designed to be used with a summoned beast. It delivers venom to targets using the viper that slithers forth from the sheath. It can also be used as a talisman, summoning a giant snake to perform a major attack. All in all, it offers quite the unique fighting style.

category=ShortSword;desc=A bow-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool. This weapon allows for various attacks using arrows formed from chakra. Holding down Strong Attack will charge it up, and you can also perform different attacks by switching arrow types. Hitting with a Normal Attack/Strong Attack variant causes an arrow wound. Hitting an enemy with an arrow wound with a Strong Attack will cause an additional effect depending on the arrow type.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

column2: Attack Scroll "Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist"
column8: category=LongSword;desc=A scroll with replicas of the seven blades of the Hidden Mist sealed within. This allows the user to summon several blades, including the Seversword: Executioner's Blade, and take advantage of each one's special properties. Press and hold strong attack to perform a long range water clone attack. In addition, when the user's health is low, defense is boosted and health is restored equal to the amount of damage dealt.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A sword inspired by legendary ninja Hashirama Senju, also known as the "Ninja God." It allows the wielder to mimic his wood style ninjutsu and sage jutsu. Fully charging a chakra jump accumulates nature energy, conferring a temporary boost that enhances physical abilities and some commands.

category=Katana;desc=A Medical Ninjutsu in which the user forms chakra into a razor-sharp scalpel and uses it to attack. Requiring very precise chakra control, few ninjas wield it often, but when they do, its wicked blade cuts through opponents like butter.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A replica of the chain used by the Masked Man who once attacked Hidden Leaf Village. Although it appears unwieldy, it is said that he used a technique that allowed it to simply "pass through" all matter. This weapon artificially replicates that in order to gauge the effectiveness of that unique fighting style.

category=ShortSword;desc=A Kunai that replicates Danzo Shimura's Wind Style combat jutsu. This survivor of the Great Ninja War easily ripped through enemy defenses with wind blade-wreathed kunai. True to its inspiration, the way this weapon rips through everything is reminiscent of his sheer brutality.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the scythe used by Akatsuki member Hidan. It contains a mechanism to extend the rope for long-range attacks to more accurately mimic his fighting style. This weapon is specially designed to inflict grievous wounds.
category=LongSword

category=Katana;desc=A sword made of an unusual metal that acts as a vessel to store the chakra of anything it touches. Unable to verify its capacity, it was feared that it would endlessly absorb chakra and become ridiculously large. However, equipping it with a mask-style chakra release valve device made it possible to use without worry and also gave it the ability to heal nearby ninja with the excess chakra.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=This kunai is inspired by the legendary ninja known as the Yellow Flash of the Leaf. It reproduces the lightning-fast Flying Raijin Jutsu mobility that he was known for and allows its wielder to cut through the battlefield in a flash.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the long sword used by the Fifth Raikage, Darui. In addition to reproducing his signature Lightning and Water Style jutsu, it also combines them to reproduce his Kekkei Genkai and Gale Style jutsu. Its black lightning edge is every bit as deadly as the man himself.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A Scientific Ninja Tool in the form of arms. Combining powerful close-range attacks and seal taijutsu, this item produces tremendous combat power on its own. Its creator designed it to exacting specifications to be effective in a variety of environments, but there just aren't many ninja who can control four arms at once.

category=Katana;desc=This weapon was reproduced to preserve the Earth Grudge fighting techniques used by Akatsuki member Kakuzu. It faithfully reproduces several of his extraordinary techniques, such as telescoping attacks using tentacles and independent fission being attacks. His bewildering onslaught is enough to strike fear in the hearts of even the most hardened ninja.

category=ShortSword;desc=This kunai is inspired by Momoshiki's form when he temporarily took control of Boruto's body. Recreated to mitigate the Otsutsuki Clan's unique Taijutsu and his "Rasendan." Its power is so great that it can pierce and destroy anything.

category=LongSword;desc=A replica of the puppet used by Kankuro, puppet master and bodyguard to the Fifth Kazekage. Once you press and hold strong attack to begin controlling the puppet, normal attacks will change to unique attacks, and you can make the puppet go up and down with the Ninjutsu buttons. You lose control of the puppet if you take damage.

category=Katana;desc=These Ninja Knuckle Knives are inspired by Shikamaru Nara, advisor to the Seventh Hokage. Allows you to replicate secret Nara Clan shadow manipulation ninjutsu, as well as the unique ninja tool combat that he specialized in. When you finish a combo, you gain one tactic stack, and each one reduces ninja tool cooldown time. Once you are at the maximum number of stacks, performing a strong attack will use them all to perform an enhanced strong attack.
category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon

category=Katana;desc=This sword's blades are connected by a wire, allowing it to move like a whip. Based on a Four Celestials ninja tool passed down in the Village of Artisans, this unique weapon boasts long reach and unusual attack angles, making it very difficult to defend against.

column2: Inuzuka Clan Food Pills & Ninja Hound
column8: category=MartialWeapon;desc=Traditional Food Pills used by the Ninja Hound Master Inuzuka Clan to boost chakra. It is now possible to recreate their wild Beast Mimicry Ninja Art with the support of their Ninja Hounds and perfectly mimic their coordinated attacks.

category=ShortSword;desc=Reproductions of Momoshiki Otsutsuki's Palm Eyes created to archive them and his fighting style. His Palm Eyes were able to produce numerous ninjutsu. His taijutsu were also highly dangerous. His rampage terrified all ninja, as well as the people of the Hidden Leaf Village.
category=ShortSword

category=MartialWeapon;desc=Ninja Equipment modeled after Rock Lee, the "Beautiful Blue Beast of Hidden Leaf." This one-of-a-kind item can replicate numerous ultra-high-speed Taijutsu honed through his outstanding effort, perseverance, and love. Holding down Strong Attack unlocks Eight Inner Gates: Gate of Pain, which enhances physical abilities but inflicts continuous damage in return. Note that Strong Attack performance is altered with this effect.

category=ShortSword;desc=A ninja sword modeled after Kakashi Hatake, also known as the "Copy Ninja." It is capable of recreating the numerous techniques he is said to have copied. Various jutsu are performed by using Strong Attack, with different attacks activated depending on which direction the user moves in.

category=ShortSword;desc=A sword modeled after Orochimaru, one of the "Legendary Sannin." Developed through his experiments in body modification and research, it is capable of replicating the unique jutsu he mastered. Its myriad of bizarre techniques strongly encapsulates Orochimaru's perspective that "a ninja must wield ninjutsu."
category=ShortSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=LongSword;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=MartialWeapon;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.
category=Katana;desc=A completely broken prototype weapon. Irreparable.

category=LongSword;desc=A large, long-bladed Scientific Ninja Tool. It can be wielded and swung by hand, or Wind Style chakra can be used to control the blade as it hovers for extended range and attack area.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A replica of the sword Kimimaro forged himself by altering his bones. It features a mechanism that can simulate the Willow Dance and Camelia Dance, replicating fighting techniques that use bone manipulation from the Kaguya Clan's Kekkei Genkai.
category=MartialWeapon

category=LongSword;desc=A katar-shaped Scientific Ninja Tool that balances the speed of Taijutsu with the cutting edge of kenjutsu. Normally attached to the fist for use, it can transform into a sword shape for greater reach. It was specially developed at the request of ninjas who prefer fighting with Taijutsu.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A pile bunker-type Scientific Ninja Tool with protruding chakra-formed stakes that oscillate. When combined with a punch, incredible destructive power can be produced. By executing a combo at the exact moment of the attack from the second stage onward, with perfect timing, the damage of the next stage of the combo is increased.

category=Katana;desc=This Tekkou is modeled after Sakura Haruno, the beloved apprentice of the Fifth Hokage. It replicates her immense strength through advanced chakra control, allowing for powerful combat that can shatter the ground with a single punch. By holding down the strong attack, the 100 Healings Jutsu is unleashed, enhancing physical abilities and continuously recovering health for a time.

category=LongSword;desc=This weapon is modeled after the scroll wielded by the Toad Sage, Jiraiya. To replicate the powerful taijutsu that comes from Sage Chakra, it is equipped with a mechanism that supports the absorption of natural energy.
category=LongSword

category=LongSword;desc=This weapon recreates the combat techniques of Isshiki Otsutsuki with his black staff. It simulates the right eye's ability, Kokugan, which can shrink and expand objects, as well as retrieve items from another dimension. This cold and formidable fighting style reminds one of his power and intent to consume the entire shinobi world.

category=ShortSword;desc=This kunai is modeled after the Rasengan, a signature Ninjutsu of the Seventh Hokage, Naruto Uzumaki. It is specifically designed to replicate his unique combat style, combining the Rasengan with Shadow Clone Jutsu. By throwing shadow clones from a distance, it allows for a one-of-a-kind fighting style that confuses and disrupts enemies.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A claw modeled after the Nine Tails Jinchuriki's while in rampaging Tailed Beast form. This especially dangerous weapon faithfully recreates the beast's ferocious chakra, allowing you to wield a fragment of its catastrophic power. Landing normal attacks on enemies builds Chakra Stock, the concentrated chakra eventually altering Strong Attacks into powerful missile attacks. The more Chakra Stock accumulated, the more shots are released.

category=ShortSword;desc=A sword inspired by the combat style of Tobirama Senju, Second Hokage and supporter of Hidden Leaf Village during its founding. It replicates various high-level ninjutsu skills he mastered, allowing the wielder to fight rationally and without emotion. You can switch between normal and strong attacks during combos. Landing a strong attack marks the enemy, and the homing capability of strong attacks is greatly enhanced against enemies with enough marks.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A weapon replicating the combat techniques of Pain, leader of the Akatsuki. Choose a direction when making a Strong Attack to summon a ninja of the Six Paths to attack for you. If the ninja is hit by an enemy attack it is defeated. Once defeated, that ninja's Strong Attack is rendered unusable. Defeating enemies grants Soul Stock, and activating an unusable Strong Attack while in possession of Soul Stock will revive that attack's corresponding ninja, so the Strong Attack can be used again.

category=LongSword;desc=Patterned after the sword of Sasuke Uchiha, the ninja also known as the "Supporting Shadow," and his signature Chidori technique. By altering the shape of the Chidori, this custom weapon faithfully recreates Sasuke's exceptional ninjutsu talent, allowing for mid- range surprise attacks and radiant bursts that inflict powerful area damage to nearby enemies.

category=Katana;desc=A chain weapon inspired by the combat style of Kushina Uzumaki of the Uzumaki Clan, second Jinchuriki of the Nine-Tails. It binds enemies with the clan's signature Sealing Jutsu, while replicating their Taijutsu known for its impressive vitality, enabling you to fight with the great power symbolic of the Uzumaki Clan.

category=ShortSword;desc=A replica of the paper shuriken used by Akatsuki member Konan. By transforming her body into paper and folding it at will in battle, Konan's graceful form was said to give off a sense of fantastical, yet fleeting beauty. When performing a Strong Attack, press up or down to unleash different variants depending on the direction.

category=MartialWeapon;desc=A weapon inspired by the scroll carried by Naruto after he mastered Sage Mode and rushed to confront the Akatsuki invasion. Featuring a support system for Sage Jutsu Chakra and Clone Jutsu, this weapon allows you to replicate Naruto's signature fighting style, combining the power of Sage Mode with a bewildering number of shadow clones.
